subject: T002 six-ADR approval

source.text: 核准 T002 六份 ADR

decision_boundaries.topology: Accepted for MVP; provider-specific deployment remains adapter/configuration-level.
decision_boundaries.providers: Provider-neutral contracts accepted; production vendor selection remains a follow-up.
decision_boundaries.content_media_rights: Policy accepted; named PUBLISHER owner and rights metadata remain required before production publish.
decision_boundaries.free_mvp: Free anonymous reading accepted; paid or token-gated change requires spec/ADR re-approval.
decision_boundaries.motion_p5: Five-pattern allowlist, court-pulse-v1, poster and reduced-motion baseline accepted.
decision_boundaries.web3: Manifest-only provenance accepted; IPFS, chain, SIWE, signer and gas writes remain off.

follow_up_gate: PR #4 may be marked ready. T002 terminal success still requires merge and read-back from main; do not dispatch T003 before that.

proof.claim: Mark explicitly approved all six T002 ADRs while preserving provider, rights, paid-access and external-Web3 safety boundaries.
